title: Huntington Library Orchid Show & Sale
location: • Brody Botanical Center at The Huntington, 1151 Oxford Road, San Marino, CA
description: Our Society participates by installing a display.  All COS members will be able to attend the show one day free of charge. You won’t have to pay the entrance fee to the Huntington and will have access not only to the orchid show but to the entire property and museums.
